scope: Frozen templates and builder only; no final source identity has yet been rendered or admitted.

control_flow_review.known_native_failure: No subsequent native group; independent scoped lint allowed only after original exit acknowledgement and stable source, tools, helper binaries and both locks.
control_flow_review.unknown_or_drift: Missing original exit, missing integrity settlement, source rewrite or tool/helper/lock drift stops all later commands. Collection remains partial.
control_flow_review.overall_success: Requires all five exact accepted cases, three distinct fresh Nextest UUIDs and three clean scoped-fix phases; failed native cannot be upgraded by lint.
control_flow_review.lint_rewrite: Full original patch/postimages retained before clean gate fails; no commit/reset/restore or continuation after rewrite.
control_flow_review.capture: Original capture/profile remain; strict raw assessor rejects LEAK even when the process exit and JUnit look successful.
control_flow_review.junit: Original report absent before invocation; same-volume rename retains complete bytes/hash. UUID must match unique actual raw run ID and not repeat; timezone-aware timestamp within original command; exact case and binary roster; failure/error/skipped/flaky child cannot pass.
control_flow_review.interruption: One Actions job deadline is authoritative; no process cancellation/retry or manufactured terminal state. Failure after timeout/cancel can leave only intent and original logs.

source_and_tool_review: Builder requires actual commit readback plus a complete recursive tree whose independent Merkle identity equals the supplied tree; exact 26 local postimages are pinned to it.
Ten reviewed runner/configuration contracts are refused if their frozen blob changes; templates do not substitute V7 or the unformatted V8 input for final source.
Runtime checks the clean event harness, exact independent source HEAD/tree, original dependency bytes, all tracked and ignored-untracked paths, and both locks before/after commands.
Rust 1.96.0, Clippy 0.1.96, just 1.51.0, Nextest 0.9.103 and physical executable hashes are checked; python3 remains an actual prerequisite for the original hooks.
Real setup/runner PE helpers come from frozen Cargo compiler-artifact records under dev-small and preserve full original/sibling byte identity.
Provider/remote-test/skip configuration is rejected by environment variable name without exporting values; original provider smoke and ignored G cases are not selected.
evidence_limits: This is static review. The author reports seven successful pure parser controls in STATIC_VALIDATION.json; this peer did not rerun them.
A final generated plan/workflow must still be tied to the actual final formatted source and reviewed before admission. No final source, harness commit, run or job identity is invented here.
The 65-minute cold-build envelope, availability of native python3, five actual Windows outcomes and three clean scoped-fix results remain unobserved.
native_case_count in a failed result is the length of accepted native_passed_cases, not a count of every attempted testcase; original per-group raw/JUnit are authoritative for attempted outcomes.
The ignored setup child is an internal process of its one active case, not an additional active Nextest selection.
This narrow validation does not settle independent elevated-delete failures or replace the full required repository CI.
